set.body:
Objective

Expose the proven architecture through a small task-oriented API while preserving current effect-form workflows.

Scope and deliverables

- Add a measurement_form constructor using between for neural measurement edges, by for the experimental query, and over for partition pairing.
- Reserve left and right for experimental relation sides.
- Add narrow convenience views for effect coupling, covariance coupling, canonical coupling, geometry alignment, and validated connectivity.
- Document capability requirements, failure modes, stage order, units, rank-one degeneracy, and reconstruction qualifications.
- Add executable examples covering same and different experimental spaces crossed with same and different neural measurements.
- Add a coherent/configuration edge example and a Parseval reconstruction example.
- Add migration guidance explaining why static geometry alignment is not established informational connectivity.
- Keep result and storage terminology explicit.

Acceptance evidence

- All examples and vignettes execute from an installed package.
- Documentation never implies covariance, connectivity, causality, PSD, or lossless tomography without the required capability.
- Existing geometry, contrast, RDM, RSA, and spectrum journeys remain unchanged.
- The public namespace stays small and has no method-specific engine or result hierarchy.
- Rendered documentation passes visual and code-output review.

Ownership boundary

Own exported wrappers, reference documentation, vignettes, README updates, and migration prose. Do not move estimation, inference, or workflow orchestration into the core.

Deferred non-goals

No formula DSL, GUI, command-line workflow, classifier catalogue, all-pairs default, or public tensor-contraction language.
set.title: Epic 9: Expose the narrow evidence-pairing API and executable documentation
